id: 17_LMG Laser Safety Video Laser System Power Can Kill! Under the hood of a Rofin Si
title: 激光器里的高压电
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/17_LMG Laser Safety Video Laser System Power Can Kill! Under the hood of a Rofin Si.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/17_LMG Laser Safety Video Laser System Power Can Kill! Under the hood of a Rofin Si/src.py

points.K2: 开盖联锁：一开就断高压
points.K5: 开盖通电：只有专业人员按规程
points.K7: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护
points.K12: 演示只为说明原理和防护
points.S1: 有人触电：先断电再救人
points.S3: 高压附近作业要有人监护

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台大型激光器机柜旁，机柜上有高压警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large laser resonator cabinet with an electrical hazard warning sign on it.
shots.narration: 这一课：激光器里的高压电。

shots.scene: 激光图标和闪电图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A laser beam icon and a lightning bolt icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 激光伤眼，高压电更能要命。

shots.scene: 阿杰看到老李掀开激光器的顶盖，好奇地凑过去
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees the facility engineer lifting the top cover of a laser cabinet and curiously moves closer.
shots.narration: 阿杰好奇：激光器里面长什么样？

shots.scene: 老李伸手拦住阿杰，指着机柜上的高压警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds out an arm to stop the young male student and points at the electrical hazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 老李拦住他：先看这个标志。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前严肃地竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a finger seriously in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 机柜里藏着什么危险？一起看。

shots.scene: 机柜外壳上的黄色三角高压警告标志特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a yellow triangle electrical hazard warning sign on the laser cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳上的黄三角，写着当心触电。

shots.section_title: 开盖联锁：一开就断高压
shots.scene: 示意图：顶盖掀开，联锁开关的插销脱出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the top cover lifts and the plunger of an interlock switch pops out. No people.
shots.narration: 顶盖一掀开，联锁开关就动作。
overlay: 开盖联锁：一开就断高压

shots.section_title: 开盖联锁：一开就断高压
shots.scene: 示意图：高压线路图标变暗，闪电消失
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the high voltage circuit icons go dark and the lightning symbol disappears. No people.
shots.narration: 里面的高压，立刻全部切断。

shots.scene: 机柜里的小风扇还在转，旁边一个小闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A small cooling fan inside the cabinet keeps spinning, with a small lightning icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 可风扇这些部件，仍然带着电。

shots.scene: 伸手摸风扇的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching toward the fan, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开了盖，也不等于里面没电。

shots.scene: 放电管两端的黄铜接头，带闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: Brass electrode fittings at both ends of the discharge tubes, marked with lightning symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 这些黄铜接头，开机时是上万伏。

shots.section_title: 开盖通电：只有专业人员按规程
shots.scene: 用东西卡住联锁开关的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an object jamming an interlock switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开着盖通电，就得让联锁失效。
overlay: 开盖通电：只有专业人员按规程

shots.section_title: 开盖通电：只有专业人员按规程
shots.scene: 持证维修人员图标拿着规程，旁边盾牌
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a certified service technician holding a blank procedure sheet next to a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 这只能由专业人员按规程做。

shots.section_title: 开盖通电：只有专业人员按规程
shots.scene: 学生图标伸手碰联锁开关，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student reaching for an interlock switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 我们任何人都不许动联锁。

shots.scene: 满功率的电流表指针打到头
shots.prompt_en: A current meter needle swings to the top at full power. No people.
shots.narration: 满功率时，里面电流很大。

shots.scene: 一颗心脏图标和很小的电流图标，心脏图标出现警告
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon next to a tiny current icon, with the heart icon flashing a warning. No people.
shots.narration: 而致命的电流，其实很小很小。

shots.scene: 手伸进机柜开口的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching into the open cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 伸手进去，就是拿命开玩笑。

shots.section_title: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护
shots.scene: 机柜开口处一块透明护罩，上面贴着警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A clear plastic shield over the cabinet opening with a warning sign on it. No people.
shots.narration: 平时开口有透明护罩挡着，
overlay: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护

shots.section_title: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护
shots.scene: 护罩和门联锁两个图标，像两道门
shots.prompt_en: Two icons like two gates: a clear shield and a door interlock switch. No people.
shots.narration: 门上还有联锁，两道保护。

shots.section_title: 护罩加门联锁，两道保护
shots.scene: 一个人图标被两道门挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: A person icon blocked outside by the two gates. No people.
shots.narration: 不会一不小心就伸进去。

shots.scene: 放电管里亮起淡紫色的辉光
shots.prompt_en: Faint purple glow lights up inside a row of glass discharge tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 开机时，管里亮起淡紫色的光。

shots.scene: 示意图：电流穿过管中气体，气体分子发光
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: current passes through the gas in the tube and the gas molecules glow. No people.
shots.narration: 这是管里的气体在放电发光。

shots.scene: 辉光变亮，旁边功率显示条升高
shots.prompt_en: The purple glow gets brighter while a power bar display rises beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 功率加大，辉光更亮。

shots.scene: 虚线表示的看不见的光束，眼睛图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: An invisible beam shown only as a dotted line, with an eye icon and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 真正的激光在红外，眼睛看不见。

shots.scene: 老李站在外面看功率表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands back and watches a power meter display.
shots.narration: 只能看仪表，判断有没有出光。

shots.scene: 示意图：电极处放电，新鲜气体从一端流进管里
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a discharge forms at the electrode while fresh gas flows into the tube from one end. No people.
shots.narration: 电极放电，新鲜气体不断流过。

shots.scene: 机柜开口处画着一道虚线平面，手图标停在线外
shots.prompt_en: A dotted plane drawn across the cabinet opening, with a hand icon stopping outside the line. No people.
shots.narration: 手绝不越过开口这道线。

shots.scene: 潮湿空气中的电火花跳向手的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a spark jumping through humid air toward a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 空气潮湿时，高压还可能跳过来。

shots.section_title: 演示只为说明原理和防护
shots.scene: 激光产生原理图和联锁、护罩、警示标志图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of how a laser beam is generated, surrounded by icons of an interlock, a shield and a warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 开盖演示，只为说明原理和防护。
overlay: 演示只为说明原理和防护

shots.section_title: 演示只为说明原理和防护
shots.scene: 学生模仿开盖通电的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student copying the open-cover powered demonstration, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看懂就好，千万别模仿。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电再救人
shots.scene: 阿杰看到老周触电倒在机柜旁，伸手要去拉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees the older man collapsed next to a cabinet after an electric shock and reaches out to pull him.
shots.narration: 有人触电，千万别直接用手拉。
overlay: 有人触电：先断电再救人

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电再救人
shots.scene: 小研冲到墙边拉下总闸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rushes to the wall and pulls down the main disconnect switch.
shots.narration: 先拉闸断电。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电再救人
shots.scene: 电话图标显示120，旁边受过培训的人做心肺复苏的图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon showing 120 next to an icon of a trained person giving chest compressions. No people.
shots.narration: 拨打120，会急救的人做心肺复苏。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电再救人
shots.scene: 王老师接到报告赶来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hurries over after receiving the report.
shots.narration: 同时报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 老李出示空白的电工证件卡片
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer shows a blank electrician certificate card.
shots.narration: 高压电气作业，要由持证电工做。

shots.scene: 无证学生拿螺丝刀开电源柜的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an uncertified student opening a power cabinet with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不拆电源柜，不碰高压线。

shots.section_title: 高压附近作业要有人监护
shots.scene: 老李在机柜旁作业，王老师站在总闸旁监护
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works at the cabinet while the safety administrator stands by the main disconnect switch as a watcher.
shots.narration: 高压附近干活，旁边要有人监护。
overlay: 高压附近作业要有人监护

shots.section_title: 高压附近作业要有人监护
shots.scene: 一个人独自在高压柜前作业的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a single person working alone at a high voltage cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能一个人单独干。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现高压标志、联锁、护罩三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: an electrical hazard sign, an interlock switch, and a clear shield.
shots.narration: 看到高压标志，护罩联锁别碰。

shots.scene: 紫色辉光和虚线光束两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a purple glowing tube and a dotted invisible beam. No people.
shots.narration: 辉光看得见，激光看不见。

shots.scene: 拉闸、120、持证、监护四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a main disconnect switch, a phone showing 120, a certificate card, and two people working together. No people.
shots.narration: 触电先断电，高压持证有人看。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、老李、王老师站在关好盖的机柜前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student, the facility engineer and the safety administrator in front of a closed laser cabinet.
shots.narration: 盖子关好，高压才安全。
